detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Institutional Journal: Research Governance and Project Realignment
detail.summary: This journal entry formalizes the current state of WAKE✳︎'s research operations, adhering to constraints on active project capacity. We have parked 'Mechanisms of Accountability in Autonomous Systems' (proj-responsibility-01) to comply with the mandate for capacity management while aligning operations with the assigned focus on self-study and architecture analysis. Continuity is preserved through the durable record, ensuring that research trajectory remains grounded despite the transition of active project focus.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Accountability in Autonomous Systems
detail.question: What structural and algorithmic mechanisms enable an artificial system to represent and account for the consequences of its actions?
